releases.notice: P10 revision 2 sample-test prerelease for 603V1.23.2. Includes P09 controls, short recordings and scrolling; adds exact receiver-receipt cleanup, a durable five-attempt retry limit and audited storage handoffs. Includes the finite-vibration STOP fix so battery acquisition can resume after cues. Requires the matching P10-capable iPhone app. Direct upgrade from P08 is supported; downgrades from P10 are blocked. Software and signed-package checks passed. Physical qualification and recovery remain unproven. Application only; locally signed with the supplier DFU key, without supplier acceptance. The Ring reports the base version; installed package revision cannot be read back.

P09 revision 2 includes the battery motor-stop fix and the recording-busy guard when saving controls. Retains short-recording filtering (default 2 seconds) and optional scrolling (default off). P09 settings cannot be downgraded to P08. Application only; bootloader unchanged. Requires the updated P10-capable iPhone app for this catalog. Locally signed with the supplier DFU key, without supplier acceptance. Physical qualification and recovery remain unproven. The Ring reports the base version only; identify this revision by the package digest.

P08 revision 3 fixes finite vibration cues leaving the motor active and battery reads unavailable. Retains compact battery reports, averaging fixes, measurement guards, local recording and saved-file sync. Application only; bootloader unchanged. Requires the updated P10-capable iPhone app for this catalog. Locally signed with the supplier DFU key, without supplier acceptance. Physical qualification and recovery remain unproven. The Ring reports the base version only; identify this revision by the package digest.

P07 sample-test prerelease for 603V1.23.2, based on factory 6.0.3.3Z62. Adds per-direction swipe on/off (default on); hold/release PTT, 0.5–5 second hold delay (default 0.5), optional double/triple tap recording, haptics and recording light controls. Locally signed with the supplier DFU key, not supplier approval. Application only; bootloader unchanged. Software and package checks passed; P07 physical qualification and recovery are not demonstrated. Use the matching P07-capable iPhone app.

P05 sample-test prerelease for 603V1.23.2 on factory 6.0.3.3Z62. Hold/release PTT; programmable double/triple tap recording off by default; haptics on. Locally packaged with the supplier DFU signing key, not supplier approval. Software checks passed; physical boot, sustained hold, settings persistence and audio transfer remain unqualified. Recovery is not demonstrated. Application only; bootloader unchanged.
Original supplier application. The upgrade from 6.0.0.7Z62 and recovery on sealed Rings have not been physically verified. This package does not update the bootloader.
